user.title: Add a town's news
user.description: Paste the RSS feed URL of the town's Facebook page (generated by rss.app, FetchRSS…) or any other RSS / Atom feed.

data_description.name: Town name, used for the device and its entities.

error.cannot_connect: Could not download the feed. Check the URL.
error.invalid_feed: The URL does not return a valid RSS or Atom feed.

data_description.max_posts: Number of posts in the sensor's posts attribute.
data_description.keywords: A post containing one of these words fires the "important" event. Whole word, case and accent insensitive, s or x plural included.
